title: Amazing Benefits of a Breast Lift

html:
Do you want to make changes to your appearance in order to boost your self-esteem and confidence? A breast lift can correct sagging breasts that have sagged naturally with gravity and age. It works by lifting the breast to a higher position by either making the surrounding tissues tighter or removing extra skin. At Hanemann Plastic Surgery, we take pride in offering the best breast lift treatment by ensuring you always get the right size, elevation, and contour of your breasts.
There are various benefits of breast lift surgery. Some of them include:
1. Raises Drooping or Sagging Breasts
The main benefit of a breast lift is its ability to alter the size, shape, feel and contours of your breasts. Breasts can droop or lose shape as a result of aging, pregnancy, or weight fluctuations. For people who like wearing bikinis, sagging breasts can make them feel unsatisfied with how their breasts look. A breast lift lets you feel and look better as it recaptures a youthful appearance.
2. Reduced Skin Irritation
Breasts that are sagging or low sitting can cause skin irritation due to excess skin. For instance, sagging breasts can cause the sides of the breasts to rub against your underarms or against the skin of your torso. Usually, this leads to chafing that makes wearing tops feel very uncomfortable.
3. Improved Physical Health
A breast lift surgery can enhance your physical health by reducing the impact of your breast weight on your chest. In turn, this leads to a reduction in neck and back pain, especially for women with large breasts. Also, drooping breasts can cause thrush, rashes, or other skin infections under the breast.
4. Improves Areolas Appearance
Sagging breasts can cause your areolas and nipples to point down, grow/stretch unnaturally larger or sag on the sides. A breast lift allows you to reposition and reshape your breasts as well as your nipple-areolar complex thus giving a forward and natural projectile.
5. Boosts Self-Esteem and Confidence
This treatment causes mental and physical well-being among women. This translates to improvement in your confidence and self-esteem levels. Whenever people feel more like themselves, they are usually more empowered in their personal life and work. Moreover, the quality of life you live majorly depends on how you feel about yourself.
Do you wish to change or modify the shape, size, elevation, and contour of your breasts? Feel free contact the experts at Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge to learn more. Contact us today to schedule your consultation!
